what: Launcher call omits the required prompt source
scenario_or_breakage: Passing only --description-text with --mode description makes both launchers exit 2 because they require exactly one of --prompt, --prompt-file, or --agent-file, so every tier reports no patch and the revision waterfall never works
suggested_fix: Pass the composed prompt via --prompt-file "$prompt_path" or --prompt "$prompt_text"; keep --description-text only if using an agent-file render path

what: Proposed git apply invocation relies on --unsafe-paths as if it were a plan-file allowlist
scenario_or_breakage: --unsafe-paths accepts patches that touch outside the working area; an LLM-emitted diff can modify unrelated files before the script notices the plan trailer or emit-plan gate
suggested_fix: Remove --unsafe-paths and explicitly reject any diff whose touched path is not the canonical plan-file path before git apply --check/apply

what: The --plan-file argv can diverge from the file validated by EMIT_PLAN
scenario_or_breakage: revise-plan-with-waterfall.sh may apply a patch to an arbitrary --plan-file while design-driver/emit-plan validates $DESIGN_TMPDIR/plan.txt, producing false ok/fail results and stale diff-lines.txt
suggested_fix: Add preflight requiring canonical --plan-file to equal "$design_tmpdir/plan.txt", or change the proposed validation path to use a helper that validates the same file being modified

what: The file-replacement patch-format path is future-facing scope in a SIMPLE lane
scenario_or_breakage: The plan adds a second patch protocol, validator branch, docs contract, and harness case for a possible future switch, increasing maintenance surface before the integration needs it
suggested_fix: Drop --patch-format file-replacement and its test/docs branches for this PR; keep unified diff only unless the current caller requires replacement mode
